description: src/lib.rs:199-202 — The None arm of the match on path.last() uses debug_assert!(false, "dfs called with empty path") to signal an invariant violation, then returns Ok(false). The correct Rust idiom for invariant violations is unreachable!() (or debug_unreachable! from the unreachable crate for no_std-safe release builds). debug_assert!(false) silently continues after the assertion in release builds, meaning the caller gets a spurious Ok(false) rather than a panic. At minimum use unreachable!("...") so debug builds panic loudly; in release builds this generates an optimization hint to the compiler that the branch is unreachable.
title: [rusty/pkix-path-builder] debug_assert!(false,...) should be unreachable!()
